# agentgateway_runtime (Data Source)

Build, mode and config-reload information reported by GET /api/runtime.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Build, mode and config-reload information reported by the gateway's
# admin API. Use it to pin a Terraform run to the release it was written for.
data "agentgateway_runtime" "current" {}

output "gateway_build_version" {
  value = data.agentgateway_runtime.current.build_version
}

output "gateway_storage_mode" {
  value = data.agentgateway_runtime.current.config_store_mode
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `build_version` (String) Gateway build version (`build.version`).
- `config_reload_last_error` (String) Error from the last config reload, empty when it succeeded.
- `config_reload_synchronized` (Boolean) Whether the last config reload completed successfully.
- `config_store_mode` (String) Config storage mode, `file`, `hybrid` or `readOnly`.
- `gateway_mode` (String) Gateway mode, `standalone` or `xds`.
- `git_revision` (String) Git revision the gateway was built from.
- `id` (String) Stable identity of the data source: `runtime`.
